name: Lab API
summary: Closed models run on the lab's own API (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), directly or through a gateway that forwards to it. The weights aren't published, so the lab is the default host; the main alternative is the same model resold on a cloud platform such as Bedrock, Vertex or Azure.
how: Pick a closed model and get an API key from its lab, or from a gateway
Send requests to the lab's endpoint, directly or through the gateway
The lab runs the model on its own infrastructure and bills per token
facts: The company that trained the model also serves it
Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Gemini API
The same closed models on Bedrock, Vertex or Azure
Stacks built on a closed model that name no other host
Newest models and features first, but one vendor's capacity and data terms
goodFor: Using closed frontier models as soon as they ship
watchOut: Prompts and outputs go to the lab under its data terms
Data residency and regions are often more limited than on a cloud platform
